findings.evidence: `rg` hits: `Galois/Basic.lean:202` gives `aut_mul_self_eq_one` with only `hroot`; `Galois/Exponent.lean:75-78` uses `aut_nontrivial hroot hindep` only to get `not_subsingleton`; Mathlib has `Monoid.exp_eq_one_iff` at `GroupTheory/Exponent.lean:181`.
findings.fix: Prove a general theorem, e.g. `aut_exponent_eq_two_of_nontrivial [Nontrivial (adjoin K (Set.range root) ≃ₐ[K] adjoin K (Set.range root))] (hroot ...) : Monoid.exponent ... = 2`, and derive the current independent-radicands case as a corollary using `aut_nontrivial`.
findings.issue: `aut_exponent_eq_two` assumes `[Finite ι] [NeZero (2 : K)] [Nonempty ι]` and `hindep`, but its proof only needs `hroot` plus `Nontrivial` for the automorphism group.

summary: The divisibility statement is at the natural level, but the exact exponent theorem is stated only for the square-class-independent construction instead of the general nontrivial automorphism group.
